content: {"phoneNote":"The first screen is all type with the only photo buried two-thirds down, and 'Pokličite' / 'Navodila za pot' appear three times (header bar, hero link, contact card) before any service is shown.","desktopNote":"Hero and info card read clearly, but the page is text-only until the about section, the sole tyre photo is a generic stack, and the half-empty gold CTA band plus giant footer wordmark leave dead space.","phone":{"impression":3,"hierarchy":4,"imagery":2,"spacing":3,"clutter":2,"distinctiveness":3},"desktop":{"impression":3,"hierarchy":4,"imagery":2,"spacing":3,"clutter":3,"distinctiveness":3},"fixes":["Put a workshop photo in the first screen (beside the hero on desktop, under the headline on phone) instead of leaving the whole fold typographic.","Remove the duplicate 'Pokličite nas' and 'Navodila za pot' links in the hero and CTA band; keep the header buttons (and phone bar) as the single primary action, and drop the repeated seasonal note.","Fill the empty right half of the gold CTA band (opening hours or a second photo) and shrink the oversized footer wordmark so the footer doesn't dwarf the hero."],"blockers":[]}
